route: explicit --wmi smoke only; no production import
limitations: D1h measured one owned root query; complete repeated snapshots remain unmeasured.
4096 rows is a stricter subset; frozen tree parser has a 4 MiB JSON byte cap and no explicit row cap.
Phase budgets do not promise scheduler or OS wall-clock timing; late responses fail closed.
PID tree is an instantaneous RSS estimate, not durable process identity or an authorization boundary.
All local process numeric triples cross the child pipe transiently; only owned subtree total and finite lifecycle metadata are reported.
